verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state ByteAsk uses magic-link email sign-in with no API key required, and session renewal is described as automatic — there is no mention of an API key auth mode for using ByteAsk itself (only for bringing external model provider keys via `models add --key`). No evidence supports API-key-based authentication as an alternative to the account/magic-link login for the ByteAsk service or CLI/CI use.
